---
# iot-fleet-sim defaults for the ec2 cloud provider
cloud_provider: ec2
aws_region: us-west-2

# One CloudFormation stack per lab
stack_name: "{{ env_type }}-{{ guid }}"
stack_retries: 1

bastion_instance_type: m6i.large
sim_node_instance_type: c6i.2xlarge
sim_node_count: 4
